body_text:
Every function $f : A \to B$ admits a canonical *first isomorphism
factorization*:
$$A \twoheadrightarrow A / {\sim} \xrightarrow{\sim} f[A] \hookrightarrow B$$
where $x \sim x'$ if and only if $f(x) = f(x')$.
The three components decouple the structural actions of $f$:
1. The canonical projection $\pi : A \twoheadrightarrow A / {\sim}$
is a surjection identifying elements with identical values.
2. The induced map $\bar{f} : A / {\sim} \xrightarrow{\sim} f[A]$,
given by $\bar{f}([x]) = f(x)$, is a bijection.
3. The canonical inclusion $\iota : f[A] \hookrightarrow B$ is an
injection embedding the image into the ambient codomain.
